description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableJsonField class, verifying its immutability, equality, hash code, string representation, and various behaviors related to JSON field handling.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonField, verifying its immutability, equality, hashing, string representation, and behavior of creating instances from JSON keys and values.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonField instances are immutable, considering specific fields and dependencies.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that equals and hashCode are correctly implemented for ImmutableJsonField.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullKey
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableJsonField with a null key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableJsonField with a null value throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getKeyNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Asserts that getKeyName() returns the expected string representation of the key.

methods.name: twoHashSetsWithSameJsonFieldsAreEqual
methods.description: Verifies that two sets containing equivalent JsonFields are considered equal.

methods.name: fieldHasNoDefinitionByDefault
methods.description: Checks that a newly created ImmutableJsonField has no definition by default.

methods.name: getDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that getDefinition() returns the correct definition when provided.

methods.name: fieldWithoutDefinitionIsNotMarkedAtAll
methods.description: Ensures that a field without a definition does not appear marked with any schema version marker.

methods.name: fieldWithSchemaVersionMarkerIsMarkedCorrectly
methods.description: Tests that a field marked with a schema version marker reports as marked.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString() method outputs the expected JSON-like string.

methods.name: createInstanceViaInterfaceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that creating a JsonField via its interface returns expected key and value.
